title: kleisis:schema-registry@2
description: a schema registry generated by Kleisis: the file of each contract, the exported contracts, and the file of each absolute $id of the registry closure

_schema.description: the format identifier of the registry

schemas.description: the file of each contract, relative to the root of the repository

exports.description: the contracts owned by the repository, each a key of schemas; absent for none

resources.description: the file of each absolute $id of the registry closure; absent for none

relative-path.description: a path below the root of the repository, with segments separated by '/' and no segment '..'
